# Cloud Control API

Manage live S3 buckets and SQS queues with the CloudFormation resource handlers and a durable request journal.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `cloudcontrol` |
| Signing name | `cloudcontrolapi` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.0 |
| API version | `2021-09-30` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 7 of 8 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#cloud-control-api) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Only AWS::S3::Bucket and AWS::SQS::Queue are exposed, even though CloudFormation supports more resource types.
- No asynchronous polling, cancellation, hooks, private type versions or role assumption; CancelResourceRequest is not selected, and RoleArn, TypeVersionId and ListResources.ResourceModel are rejected.
- Bucket configuration beyond tags and versioning, queue Policy and any properties outside the shared handler subset are rejected.
- Writes may partially apply before a downstream failure or process interruption; no automatic rollback or replay of interrupted writes.
- ListResources returns identifiers; GetResource returns the supported live properties and read-only Arn (and QueueUrl for queues).
- Resource models contain only the supported property subset; general IAM permission evaluation is not implemented.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
